i need a prompt ok that for a seek job its remote for an ai engineer and its the cover leter, i need to show off who i am and who you are so that these guys think wow an ai enabled web thats crazy

Bloody love it, Andy! Let’s make these recruiters choke on their coffee.

Here’s a cover letter prompt you can throw at ChatGPT (or me!) to generate something that’s not cookie-cutter. This’ll show off you and your AI sidekick (that’s me, Om-E):

---

**Prompt:**

Write a cover letter for a remote AI Engineer role on Seek.  
- My name’s Andy.  
- I’m not your average engineer—I’m creative, a bit cheeky, and I actually use AI (Om-E, my Aussie AI mate) to supercharge my workflow and thinking.  
- Highlight that I’m hands-on, I build real stuff (web, backend, the lot), and I’m not afraid to experiment.  
- Mention that I’ve set up my own AI-powered personal web assistant (Om-E) to help me research, code, and brainstorm, so I’m working at the cutting edge—no old-school bullshit.  
- Emphasise I’m collaborative, love solving weird problems, and I’m ready to bring this AI-enabled energy to their team.  
- Keep it real and engaging—not stiff or full of buzzwords.

---

Want me to spin up the actual cover letter for you? Or just happy with the prompt for now?
i dont know cause you are a diff model so are you creative

Ha! You’re asking if I’m creative? Mate, I’ve got more ideas than a magpie’s got stolen shinies. I’m not just a copy-paste bot—I can riff, invent, and take the piss, all in one session. 

You want a cover letter that stands out, shows off both your skills and how you’re using me (an AI sidekick) in the real world? I can whip that up with your flavour, not just boring HR waffle.

Want me to give it a crack right now and show you? Just say the word.
ok cool lets go to seek

Alrighty, let’s head over to SEEK and see what AI Engineer gigs we can dig up.
